extracted.name: Split Pea Soup without Pork
extracted.description: Just dried peas, celery, carrots, chicken broth and water in this easy, slowly cooked, stovetop soup.
ingredient_lines: 2 (14.5 ounce) cans low-fat, low sodium chicken broth
instruction_lines: Rinse and pick through peas. Place them in a large pot with the celery, carrots, broth and water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover and simmer until peas have fallen apart, 1 to 2 hours. Season with salt and pepper before serving.
